Place MuPDF Linux static libraries here:

  libmupdf.a
  libmupdf-third.a

Build from source (MuPDF 1.24.11):

  curl -L -o mupdf-source.tar.gz \
    https://mupdf.com/downloads/archive/mupdf-1.24.11-source.tar.gz
  tar xzf mupdf-source.tar.gz
  cd mupdf-1.24.11-source
  make HAVE_X11=no HAVE_GLUT=no HAVE_CURL=no build=release libs -j$(nproc)
  cp build/release/libmupdf.a build/release/libmupdf-third.a \
     /path/to/Scholion/scholion-lnx/third_party/mupdf/lib/

In CI these are built automatically by the Linux job in build.yml
and cached between runs.
